youtube_description:
March 8/2019
Today we will be hiking up to the top of Prairie Mountain.  The hike is 6.4 kilometers and has an elevation gain of 666 meters.  I am hiking with my friend Denis.  This hike is not so much about the distance, but is all about the elevation gain.  It was tough going up, but well worth it when you get to the top.  An added bonus hiking this trail in the winter, is when coming down you can slide on your butt.  Be careful if you do this though, as you gain speed really fast.
This is my 29th video.  Thank you very much for watching.  If you enjoyed this video please give it a thumbs up.  If you would like to see my other videos, Subscribe to my channel.  New videos weekly.  CHEERS

Thank you, 
Cary Mason
